subject: C31
required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs:132 and :248; apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/review-sheet.tsx:128; crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:3453: renderer reload does not retire the departed page's review or disclosure ownership. ReviewSheet relies on React cleanup followed by a window timer to send DiscardChange/ForgetSecret; document destruction does not guarantee either runs. The native PageLoadEvent::Started handler only retires observations, and registering the replacement delivery session only changes delivery bookkeeping. Consequently, an unrevealed issued key remains Held and revealable after its review disappeared; a pending native confirmation also retains its valid review. This violates I6's review-exit lifetime and the native editor-lease contract. Acceptance: native page teardown must invalidate its pending reviews/confirmations, dismiss disclosure, forget held keys and mark unsettled issuances forgotten-on-settle while preserving remote outcomes. Production-interface host regressions must exercise reload before reveal, during confirmation and during delayed issuance; the replacement page must receive no surviving disclosure authority, stale confirmation must apply nothing, and no mutation may be replayed.

R2 — tools/native-acceptance/legacy_assertions.py:333 and :336; tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c39.py:602: the C31 replacement mapping overstates assertion coverage. C31-N01 maps solely to C39-N01, which checks Runtime topics and board presentation but does not enforce the required Gateway key restrictions or several other inventory assertions. C31-N04 maps solely to C39-N02's review geometry/apply checks, omitting its accessibility obligations; useful existing C31 observations and C39-N04 results are not required by that mapping. Acceptance: preserve each unretired C31 obligation in an enforced assertion-level mapping. Correctly scope the Gateway Keys/detail negative assertions, require the existing same-bundle checks that establish the accessibility facts, and retain source-bound evidence for missing assertions. Qualification must reject removal or failure of those assertions; preserve historical failed records.
evidence_gaps: E1 — docs/planning/evidence/P09/native/cumulative/C31/native-acceptance.json retains C31-N01 as failed with gateway_no_version=false. The replacement C39-N01 does not test Gateway key actions; C39-N03 checks the Keys table and key-kind controls without asserting that Gateway row details exclude Issue additional key and Finish rotation. The retained evidence therefore does not establish this mandatory C31 native restriction. This is an evidence gap, not proof that the product offers forbidden actions. Passing component tests do not replace the missing native assertion.
optional_suggestions: apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/review-sheet.tsx:265: derive the header state pill from the rotation stage when showing a rotation. The retained issued and completed rotation captures both show Draft beside the title despite the panel reporting the actual completed operation.
